title: Mixture-of-Recursions: Learning Dynamic Recursive Depths for Adaptive Token-Level Computation
key_evidence: Shared recursive layers plus token-depth routing; recursion-wise KV memory and IO ratio (Nr+1)/(2Nr); first-recursion KV sharing memory ratio 1/Nr but normalized KV IO 1; 360M-base configuration has 315M non-embedding + 47M embedding params; Middle-Cycle Nr=3 reports 118M unique non-embedding params; up to 2.06x throughput is measured with continuous depth-wise batching rather than batch-1 mobile.
relevance_to_sub500m: Direct seed source for recursion, routing, cache-memory/IO formulas, strict total-parameter accounting, and latency caveats.

title: Fast Transformer Decoding: One Write-Head is All You Need
key_evidence: Introduces multi-query attention with shared keys/values across query heads to reduce incremental decoding memory bandwidth.
relevance_to_sub500m: Basis for the 1/Hq KV-cache ratio of MQA and decode-bandwidth recommendation.

title: GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints
key_evidence: Introduces grouped-query attention; reports quality close to multi-head attention while retaining much of multi-query inference efficiency.
relevance_to_sub500m: Supports GQA as the quality/bandwidth compromise and Hkv/Hq cache scaling.

title: Efficient Streaming Language Models with Attention Sinks
key_evidence: Shows naive recent-window KV eviction can fail and retaining a small set of initial attention-sink tokens enables stable streaming with bounded cache.
relevance_to_sub500m: Supports sink/prefix retention for long-running bounded-context chat.

title: Mistral 7B
key_evidence: Uses grouped-query attention and sliding-window attention as core efficiency mechanisms.
relevance_to_sub500m: Evidence that SWA + GQA is a practical architecture rather than only a theoretical cache optimization.

title: Gemma 3 Technical Report
key_evidence: Uses predominantly local attention with periodic global layers; 5:1 local-to-global interleaving reduces KV-cache requirements while preserving long-context capability.
relevance_to_sub500m: Supports a 3:1 to 5:1 local/global starting range for an edge model, subject to retraining/validation.

title: KIVI: A Tuning-Free Asymmetric 2bit Quantization for KV Cache
key_evidence: Finds keys favor per-channel quantization while values favor per-token quantization; demonstrates tuning-free asymmetric 2-bit KV; reports 2.6x lower peak memory including weights, up to 4x batch, and 2.35-3.47x throughput in serving workloads.
relevance_to_sub500m: Primary evidence that KV2 is possible, and that K/V need different quantization granularity.

title: KVQuant: Towards 10 Million Context Length LLM Inference with KV Cache Quantization
key_evidence: Uses per-channel keys, pre-RoPE key quantization, non-uniform datatypes, and dense+sparse outlier handling; reports less than 0.1 perplexity degradation at 3-bit KV on tested models and custom-kernel speedups up to about 1.7x over FP16 matrix-vector baselines.
relevance_to_sub500m: Shows nominal cache bits must be paired with packed/custom attention kernels to realize speed.

title: KVTuner: Sensitivity-Aware Layer-wise Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization for Efficient and Nearly Lossless LLM Inference
key_evidence: Offline sensitivity-aware layer-wise mixed precision; reports near-lossless average precision around 3.25 bits in some settings and up to 38.3% throughput improvement over KV8.
relevance_to_sub500m: Static layerwise mixed precision is attractive for edge kernels because runtime layouts remain regular.

title: KVLinC: KV Cache Quantization with Hadamard Rotation and Linear Correction
key_evidence: Combines Hadamard rotation with a lightweight linear correction and a custom attention kernel for aggressive KV quantization.
relevance_to_sub500m: Promising low-bit KV technique, but added correction operators must fuse/delegate on the mobile backend.

title: Don't Waste Bits! Adaptive KV-Cache Quantization for Lightweight On-Device LLMs
key_evidence: Evaluates SmolLM-135M/360M/1.7B with token-adaptive 2/4/8/16-bit KV; for SmolLM-360M on HellaSwag reports 17.75% lower decode latency than static KV quantization while remaining 0.30 accuracy points from FP16.
relevance_to_sub500m: Rare primary evidence directly at the target model-size scale; dynamic precision may still complicate accelerator kernels.

title: AWQ: Activation-aware Weight Quantization for On-Device LLM Compression and Acceleration
key_evidence: Activation-aware scaling protects salient weights; regular low-bit representation; paper reports more than 3x speedup versus its Hugging Face FP16 baseline on desktop and mobile GPUs.
relevance_to_sub500m: Strong default PTQ family for hardware-friendly W4 deployment.

title: GPTQ: Accurate Post-Training Quantization for Generative Pre-trained Transformers
key_evidence: Approximate second-order PTQ for 3/4-bit weights with small accuracy degradation; original work reports substantial GPU speedups with custom inference kernels.
relevance_to_sub500m: Reliable offline W4/W3 baseline, but serialized GPTQ layout must match the target runtime kernel.

title: SmoothQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Large Language Models
key_evidence: Moves activation outlier difficulty into weights through mathematically equivalent rescaling to enable W8A8; reports up to 1.56x speedup and 2x memory reduction on evaluated platforms.
relevance_to_sub500m: Supports benchmarking W8A8 against W4 when the NPU/ANE has superior INT8 GEMM.

title: QuIP: 2-Bit Quantization of Large Language Models With Guarantees
key_evidence: Uses incoherence processing and second-order information to make very low-bit, including 2-bit, weight quantization viable.
relevance_to_sub500m: Algorithmic foundation for extreme compression when W4 is still too large.

title: QuIP#: Even Better LLM Quantization with Hadamard Incoherence and Lattice Codebooks
key_evidence: Combines Hadamard incoherence processing with lattice/vector codebooks for strong sub-4-bit post-training quantization and fast specialized inference.
relevance_to_sub500m: Candidate for 2-3 bit storage only if a target-device vector/codebook kernel exists.

title: AQLM: Additive Quantization for Language Models
key_evidence: Additive multi-codebook quantization gives strong 2-bit rate-distortion; paper reports custom layer-level speedups of roughly 30% on GPU and up to about 4x on CPU in evaluated setups.
relevance_to_sub500m: Shows codebook quantization can be executable, but kernel portability is the edge-device gating factor.

title: QuaRot: Outlier-Free 4-Bit Inference in Rotated LLMs
key_evidence: Uses computationally equivalent rotations to suppress outliers and enable end-to-end 4-bit weights, activations, and KV cache.
relevance_to_sub500m: Strong W4A4KV4 research target if backend kernels consume low-bit activations/cache without dequant fallback.

title: SpinQuant: LLM Quantization with Learned Rotations
key_evidence: Learns rotations for quantization robustness; reports a 2.9-point zero-shot gap to full precision for W4A4KV4 Llama-2-7B and improves over random-rotation QuaRot.
relevance_to_sub500m: Evidence that learned rotations can recover quality for end-to-end 4-bit deployment.

title: QTIP: Quantization with Trellises and Incoherence Processing
key_evidence: Uses trellis-coded high-dimensional quantization with incoherence processing and designs decoding around hardware-efficient operations.
relevance_to_sub500m: Promising ultra-low-bit approach when custom kernels are acceptable.

title: ScaleBITS: Hardware-Aligned Mixed-Precision Quantization for Large Language Models
key_evidence: Block-wise hardware-aligned mixed precision targets better ultra-low-bit quality without introducing runtime precision-switch overhead.
relevance_to_sub500m: Relevant recent direction for sub-4-bit storage with more regular execution than arbitrary mixed precision.

title: T-MAC: CPU Renaissance via Table Lookup for Low-Bit LLM Deployment on Edge
key_evidence: LUT-based kernels consume low-bit weights without first dequantizing to high precision; reports up to 4x throughput and 70% energy reduction versus llama.cpp on tested CPU/edge systems.
relevance_to_sub500m: Direct evidence that low-bit speed depends on an execution kernel, not merely compressed storage.

title: SparseGPT: Massive Language Models Can Be Accurately Pruned in One-Shot
key_evidence: One-shot pruning can remove about half of weights in large models with small loss; includes unstructured and semi-structured N:M settings and combinations with quantization.
relevance_to_sub500m: Algorithmic pruning reference; edge latency benefit requires a sparse-aware kernel.

title: A Simple and Effective Pruning Approach for Large Language Models (Wanda)
key_evidence: Weight-times-activation pruning metric achieves strong one-shot unstructured sparsity without retraining.
relevance_to_sub500m: Useful compression baseline but should not be counted as speed unless the runtime consumes sparse matrices natively.

title: LLM-Pruner: On the Structural Pruning of Large Language Models
key_evidence: Prunes coupled structural groups and uses lightweight recovery rather than only setting individual weights to zero.
relevance_to_sub500m: Supports shape-reducing structured pruning when the result exports as smaller dense operators.

title: Export LLMs — ExecuTorch documentation
key_evidence: Documents KV cache, SDPA-with-KV-cache, attention sinks, int8 KV-cache quantization, local/global attention, TorchAO 8da4w, low-bit Arm paths, and backend delegation options.
relevance_to_sub500m: Primary implementation reference for a portable mobile CPU/backend baseline.

title: Qualcomm AI Engine Direct Backend — ExecuTorch documentation
key_evidence: Documents QNN delegation to Qualcomm accelerators and quantization schemes including 8a8w, 16a16w, 16a8w, 16a4w, and 16a4w_block; the Llama tutorial documents mixed precision and int8 KV cache.
relevance_to_sub500m: Defines practical weight/activation/cache formats for Snapdragon/HTP deployment and highlights the need to stay inside delegated operators.

title: XNNPACK Quantization — ExecuTorch documentation
key_evidence: Documents low-bit LLM paths including 4-bit weights with dynamic 8-bit activations and quantized embedding support.
relevance_to_sub500m: Concrete Arm/mobile CPU path for a W4A8 baseline.

title: Vulkan Quantization — ExecuTorch documentation
key_evidence: Documents W8/W4 quantized linear layers, weight-only W4 and dynamic-A8/W4; notes dynamic activation quantization can exploit accelerated integer dot-product instructions.
relevance_to_sub500m: Supports direct target-device comparison of W4A16 versus W4A8 on mobile GPUs.

title: Optimize Model Overview — coremltools documentation
key_evidence: Explains that compressed weights may be decompressed eagerly or just in time; discusses palettization, W8A8 on newer Neural Engine hardware, INT4 per-block GPU quantization, and pruning latency effects by compute unit.
relevance_to_sub500m: Primary evidence that file-size compression does not guarantee latency and that Apple precision choice should be compute-unit-specific.

title: Stateful Models — coremltools documentation
key_evidence: Documents persistent state on iOS 18/macOS 15+ and explicitly describes KV cache as a language-model use case with in-place state updates.
relevance_to_sub500m: Supports preallocated/stateful KV design on Apple devices and avoids host-side cache copying.

title: RoPE-Aware Bit Allocation for KV-Cache Quantization
key_evidence: Block-GTQ allocates key bits using two-dimensional RoPE frequency blocks; packed K3V3 path reports 3.24x KV compression and 1.34x speedup over FP16 FlashAttention2 at 128K on H800 in the paper.
relevance_to_sub500m: Strong recent algorithmic reference for low-bit keys; demonstrated kernel is datacenter GPU, so mobile realization remains unproven.

title: llama.cpp Feature Matrix
key_evidence: Documents K-quants, KV-cache quantization, Flash Attention and architecture/backend support; feature matrix marks I-quants slower than comparable K-quants on ARM NEON/Metal.
relevance_to_sub500m: Supports K-quant around 4 bits as a portable latency baseline and IQ2/IQ3 mainly as capacity experiments on ARM/Apple.

title: MLC LLM Quick Start
key_evidence: Documents compiled low-bit model families such as q4f16 and deployment paths spanning Android and iOS/mobile GPUs.
relevance_to_sub500m: Useful cross-platform compiler baseline; custom routing/cache operators still require verification for fusion and fallback.
